name: Christmas Charity Market
description: Handmade gifts and food stalls run by students. Everything raised goes to local social projects.

name: Pro Bono Consulting Info Session
description: Learn how student teams advise NGOs and social enterprises, and how to join the next project cycle.

name: Investment Banking Workshop
description: Hands-on session on valuation and pitch books, with tips to prepare for investment banking interviews.

name: Luxury Brand Networking Evening
description: Meet professionals from fashion and luxury houses over drinks and short talks about careers in the sector.

name: Consulting Case Competition
description: Teams of four solve a real business case and present it to a jury of consultants. Prizes for the top three.

name: International Student Welcome Night
description: Kick off the semester with exchange and full-time students from all over the world. Music, snacks and games.

name: Startup Pitch Night
description: Student founders pitch their startups in three minutes to investors and mentors. Networking afterwards.

name: Esade Padel Tournament
description: Doubles tournament open to all levels. Sign up with a partner; rackets available on site.

name: Consulting Academy
description: Three-hour bootcamp on case interviews: frameworks, market sizing and practice cases in small groups.

name: Sant Cugat Charity Run – 5K
description: A 5 km solidarity run for students, staff and families. The registration fee is donated to a local charity.

name: Innovation & AI Workshop
description: Build a small AI prototype for a business problem. No coding experience needed; bring your laptop.

name: Women in Leadership Panel
description: Women executives share their career paths and answer questions about leadership and growth.

name: Barcelona Culture Walk: Gothic Quarter
description: Guided walk through the history, legends and hidden corners of Barcelona's old town.

name: Sustainability & Social Impact Forum
description: Talks and round tables with social entrepreneurs and impact investors on building sustainable businesses.

name: Moot Court Competition
description: Law students argue a mock case before a panel of lawyers and judges. Open to anyone who wants to watch.

name: Esade Finance Summit
description: A day of talks on markets, private equity and fintech, with speakers from leading financial firms.

name: Shark Tank Esade
description: Student startups face a panel of investors who decide live whether to back them.

name: IdeaUp Challenge
description: Ideation challenge: turn a real company's problem into an innovative solution in one afternoon.

name: Legal Tech Talk
description: How technology and AI are changing legal work, explained by lawyers and legal tech founders.

name: Campus Party
description: The big student party of the spring term, with DJs, food trucks and activities across the campus.

name: Board Olympics
description: Teams compete in a day of sports and games. Form a team with your classmates and win the cup.

name: Food Bank Volunteering Day
description: Spend a morning sorting and packing food donations with other students. Transport from campus included.

name: TEDx Esade
description: Short talks with ideas worth spreading from speakers in business, science and culture.

name: Startup Turbo
description: Intensive programme day for early-stage student startups: mentoring sessions and a demo with investors.

name: Esade Spring Festival
description: End-of-year festival with live music, association stands and food, open to the whole Esade community.
